sylvia: Lumenix reached out — they can ship two EAP units next week. They asked for our bench harness and a short NDA. Who picks up bench ownership? @omar?
omar: I can own the harness and parsers. Quick question: do we test with int8 and fp16, and do we run a soak?
claire: Legal prefers mutual embargo + aggregated metrics only. They'll send a redline. 7-business-day embargo OK? :ok_hand:
dave-ops: Lab window Tue/Wed. Carrier: UPS overnight. Need serials, package weight, and whether partner preloads drivers. We'll refuse packages outside window.
nina-lumenix: We can preload drivers and provide container image after NDA. Typical stress config: `--threads=40 --seq=2048`. Also note: some thermal variance after 20m.
omar: Suggested bench plan: 2 cold runs, 1 warm run, 1x 25m soak. Metrics: p50/p95, tokens/s, avg_power, max_temp. Example command (repo):
```
./bench.sh \
  --model redwood/fast-7b \
  --seq 2048 \
  --batch 1 \
  --quant int8,fp16 \
  --threads 40 \
  --collect gpu_temp,gpu_power,gpu_freq \
  --soak 1500
```
priya: Marketing note: if embargo approved, need assets + one-sentence partner blurb. PM wants only raw numbers in listing, no adjectives.
claire: NDA redline link (incoming). We'll require synthetic prompts and scrubbed traces.
nina-lumenix: Uploading NDA redline now: https://lumenix-files.s3/nda_redline_1787.pdf. We'll post image once signed.
sylvia: Action items:
- omar: bench harness, run script, parser by Fri (1787710000)
- dave-ops: confirm lab slot + COA form (due Thu 1787690000)
- claire: finalize NDA + embargo clause (due Wed 1787685000)
- nina-lumenix: confirm image upload and serials after NDA
I'll create a kickoff calendar and include checklist. Thanks :raised_hands:
